# funnel_gcs_export (Resource)

GCS export

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch export fields
data "funnel_export_field" "date" {
  workspace = var.workspace_id
  id        = "date"
}

data "funnel_export_field" "campaign_name" {
  workspace = var.workspace_id
  id        = "campaign_name"
}

data "funnel_export_field" "impressions" {
  workspace = var.workspace_id
  id        = "impressions"
}

data "funnel_export_field" "cost" {
  workspace = var.workspace_id
  id        = "cost"
}

# Basic GCS export with Parquet format
resource "funnel_gcs_export" "basic" {
  workspace = var.workspace_id
  name      = "Daily Marketing Data to GCS"
  enabled   = true
  schedule  = "CRON_TZ=UTC 0 2 * * *" # Daily at 2 AM (UTC)

  destination = {
    bucket             = "my-funnel-exports"
    path               = "marketing-data"
    output_id_template = "funnel_export_{date}"
    credentials_ref    = "gcs-service-account-key"
    file_format        = "parquet"
  }

  fields = [
    data.funnel_export_field.date,
    data.funnel_export_field.campaign_name,
    data.funnel_export_field.impressions,
    data.funnel_export_field.cost
  ]

  range = {
    end = "today"
    rolling_start = {
      period  = "month"
      periods = 3
    }
  }

  partition_by = "month"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (Attributes) GCS destination (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination))
- `fields` (Attributes List) Export fields as a list of fields from export_field data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `name` (String) Export name. Must not be empty.
- `partition_by` (String) How to split the export into parts. One of: `day`, `month`, `quarter`, `year`, `all` or `none`. **Recommended:** `month`
  - `day`, `month`, `quarter`, `year`: Export a part per period with all data that has values for Funnel date.
  - `all`: Single part. Export one single fully aggregated part with all data that has values for Funnel date (max 1M rows).
  - `none`: Single part without Funnel date values. Export a single file with only data that has no values for Funnel date.
- `range` (Attributes) Export range (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--range))
- `schedule` (String) Export schedule as a cron expression, optionally prefixed with `CRON_TZ=<IANA time zone>`. For example, `CRON_TZ=Europe/Stockholm 10 8 * * *` runs daily at 8:10 am (Europe/Stockholm). Must not be empty.
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID. Must be exactly 20 characters (letters, digits, `-` and `_`).

### Optional

- `currency` (String) Export currency as an uppercase ISO 4217 code, e.g. `USD` or `EUR`. If not set, the workspace default currency is used.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the export is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `filters` (Attributes List) Export filters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `notes` (String) Export notes that can be seen in the Funnel app

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Export identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination`

Required:

- `bucket` (String) GCS bucket for the export. Must be 3-222 characters, contain only lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`, and start and end with a letter or digit.
- `file_format` (String) File format of the export. One of: `csv`, `tsv`, or `parquet`.
- `output_id_template` (String) Output ID template for the export. Must not be empty.
- `path` (String) Path for the export. Must be 1-1024 characters.

Optional:

- `credentials_ref` (String) Reference to GCS credentials secret
- `gzip` (Boolean) Whether to gzip the exported files. Defaults to `true` for `csv` and `tsv`. Parquet files are already compressed, so it is always `false` for `parquet` and can't be set to `true`.


<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Optional:

- `export_name` (String) Export column name (optional override)
- `export_type` (String) Export type for the field (optional override)
- `id` (String) Field ID fetched from data source export_field
- `type` (String) Field type fetched from data source export_field


<a id="nestedatt--range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `range`

Optional:

- `end` (String) End date for the export range
- `rolling_end` (Attributes) Relative end date for the time range of the export (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--range--rolling_end))
- `rolling_start` (Attributes) Relative start date for the time range of the export. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--range--rolling_start))
- `start` (String) Start date for the export range

<a id="nestedatt--range--rolling_end"></a>
### Nested Schema for `range.rolling_end`

Required:

- `period` (String) Unit for the relative time range. One of: `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, or `year`.
- `periods` (Number) Number of periods for the relative time range, negative value means past. For example periods=-7 and period=day means last 7 days.


<a id="nestedatt--range--rolling_start"></a>
### Nested Schema for `range.rolling_start`

Required:

- `period` (String) Unit for the relative time range. One of: `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, or `year`.
- `periods` (Number) Number of periods for the relative time range. Only positive values are allowed.



<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>

Required:

- `field_id` (String) Field ID to filter on

Optional:

- `operation` (String) Filter operation (e.g., equals, contains)
- `or` (Attributes List) OR conditions for the filter (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--or))
- `value` (String) Value to filter by

<a id="nestedatt--filters--or"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.or`

Required:

- `operation` (String) Filter operation (e.g., equals, contains)
- `value` (String) Value to filter by

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import funnel_gcs_export.example <workspace_id>/<export_id>
```
